Curios.Tidal-Essence.Name: Tidal Essence
Curios.Tidal-Essence.Description: Frigid to the touch, coarse like sea salt. Used for purposes mundane and arcane.
Curios.Flare-Essence.Name: Flare Essence
Curios.Flare-Essence.Description: Radiates a supernatural heat that doesn't burn. Used for purposes mundane and arcane.
Curios.Storm-Essence.Name: Storm Essence
Curios.Storm-Essence.Description: Crackling brilliantly with magical electricity. Used for purposes mundane and arcane.
Curios.Druidic-Essence.Name: Druidic Essence
Curios.Druidic-Essence.Description: Smells like rain on concrete, feels like loam. Used for purposes mundane and arcane.
Curios.Aether-Essence.Name: Aether Essence
Curios.Aether-Essence.Description: Brings on a sense of balance and calm. Used for purposes mundane and arcane.
